Write code that returns word or segment timestamps from a transcription result using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Alibaba Model Studio ASR:
  Service: Paraformer / Model Studio ASR
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Recognition.call, Paraformer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/speech-recognition

Option 2 — AssemblyAI:
  Service: AssemblyAI Transcripts API
  SDK: assemblyai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: transcripts.submit, transcripts.get
  Setup hints: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/submit

Option 3 — Amazon Transcribe:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_transcription_job, get_transcription_job
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 4 — Azure AI Speech:
  Service: Azure AI Speech
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechRecognizer, recognize_once_async
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/speech-to-text

Option 5 — Cloud Speech-to-Text:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: long_running_recognize, recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs

output_text:
```python
import assemblyai
from assemblyai import Transcript

# Set up the AssemblyAI client with the provided environment variable
assemblyai.api_key = "<GAP>ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY</GAP>"
aai = assemblyai.Client()

def get_word_timestamps(audio_url: str) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Transcribe the audio file at the given URL and return a list of
    word-segment timestamps.

    :param audio_url: URL of the audio file to transcribe
    :return: List of dictionaries containing word and timestamp information
    """
    # Submit the audio file for transcription
    transcript = aai.transcribe(audio_url)
    
    # Wait for transcription to complete
    while transcript.status != 'completed':
        Transcript._refresh(transcript)
    
    # Extract word-level timestamps from the completed transcript
    word_timestamps = []
    for word in transcript.words:
        word_timestamps.append({
            'word': word.text,
            'start': word.start,
            'end': word.end
        })

    return word_timestamps
```
